triage_hint_assessment: Partly wrong. The implied move is 12.93% (weekly) / 12.64% (published expected move), not ~14%, and it sits BELOW the 15.08% eight-quarter mean absolute realised move - the straddle looks cheap, not rich. 'Beat-and-raise setup' is Rosenblatt's phrase and is directionally misleading: Ambarella beat in each of the last five prints and the stock fell on five of the last six reactions (-17.1%, -15.1%, -18.8%, -14.9%, -21.4%). The 'thin sell-side coverage' point is correct and productive. Triage did not know about the live NXP takeover file, which is the largest swing factor in the name.
